reviews.text: Really loving this body lotion! It feels smooth and nourishing, leaving my skin soft, hydrated, and beautifully moisturised. It absorbs nicely without feeling too greasy and has become a lovely part of my daily routine. Definitely recommend!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款身體乳！質地順滑、滋養，令皮膚柔軟、水潤、補濕效果好靚。吸收好好，唔會太油膩，已經成為我日常護理嘅一部分。絕對推薦！

reviews.text: I really enjoy using the Fine Today Urea Body Milk. It has a smooth, lightweight texture that spreads easily over the skin and absorbs nicely without leaving a greasy feeling. It leaves my skin feeling soft, moisturized, and comfortable, especially when my skin feels dry. I like using it after showering as part of my daily body care routine. It’s easy to apply and gives my skin a nice feeling of hydration without being too heavy. Overall, it’s a simple and practical body moisturizer that I’m happy to use regularly.
reviews.zh: 我好享受用 Fine Today 尿素身體乳。質地順滑、輕盈，推開好容易，吸收好好，冇油膩感。用完令皮膚柔軟、水潤、舒適，尤其係皮膚乾嗰陣。我習慣淋完浴之後用，成為我日常身體護理嘅一部分。搽落好容易，令皮膚有好舒服嘅補濕感，但唔會太厚重。整體嚟講，係一款簡單實用嘅身體保濕產品，我好樂意經常用。

為咗做比較，我只係喺左腳用，右腳就乜都冇搽，一個星期之後效果已經完全睇得出！

reviews.text:
Este producto deja la piel hidratada pero sin esa sensación humeda o sticky. 
Yo soy autista y tengo mucha sensibilidad y no tolero las sensaciones de la mayoría de las cremas esta me encantó. 

Con el tema de los puntitos de la piel a la tercera puesta noté resultados
reviews.zh:
呢款產品令皮膚補濕，但冇嗰種潮濕或者黏黏嘅感覺。
我有自閉症，對觸感好敏感，大部分面霜嘅感覺我都受唔到，呢款我好鍾意。
至於皮膚上嗰啲小點點，搽到第三次我就見到效果。

reviews.text: I’ve been on a mission to find products that will help reduce the KP on my arms and legs. I was looking for an high Urea content lotion for smoothing and moisturizing that isn’t too thick. While my skin is dry, I live in a hot/humid climate so lotions that are too thick leave me feeling sticky and gross in the summer. The texture of this lotion is lightweight, milky lotion that adds a ton of hydration but blends in quickly and feels very lightweight. Exactly what I was looking for and will be a staple for me.
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一啲可以減少手臂同腿上 KP（毛囊角化症）嘅產品。我想搵一款高尿素含量、用嚟滑順同保濕，但又唔會太厚身嘅乳液。我皮膚乾，但我住喺炎熱潮濕嘅地方，所以太厚嘅乳液夏天會令我覺得黏膩同好唔舒服。呢款乳液質地輕盈、似奶狀，補濕效果好多，但推開好快，感覺好輕身。正正係我想要嘅，會成為我嘅必備產品。

reviews.text: I use this to moisturize my hands and feet. It provides good, lightweight hydration and absorbs easily without leaving any sticky residue. The scent is lovely, though I personally wish it were a bit stronger
reviews.zh: 我用嚟補濕雙手同雙腳。補濕效果好好、質地輕盈，容易吸收，冇任何黏膩殘留。香味好好聞，不過我個人希望香味再濃少少。

reviews.text: Bought primarily to use on my feet so they stay hydrated through the night without risking ashy ankles when I rush out the house— and it’s perfect for that! Also using it on other areas of drier skin and love how little you need for large areas.
reviews.zh: 我主要係買嚟搽腳，等佢哋整晚都保持水潤，唔會因為趕住出門而令腳踝變得乾灰——用嚟做呢個用途好啱！我亦會搽喺其他比較乾嘅皮膚位置，好鍾意大面積都只需要少少份量。
